paragraphs: Shein is a big online shop for cheap clothes. It sells to people in Europe through a company in Dublin.
In 2025, this company sold goods worth more than €7.9 billion in Europe. It paid about €17.5 million in tax in Ireland. Its profit was about €117 million. That is lower than in 2024.
The company had 389 workers on average in 2025. In 2024, it had 254.

Since July, people in the EU pay an extra €3 on cheap goods from outside the EU. This is for goods under €150. The rule is for online shops like Shein and Temu. In May, Shein also opened a new warehouse near Dublin.
sentZh: Shein是一家販售便宜衣服的大型網路商店。
它透過一家都柏林的公司把商品賣給歐洲的人。
2025年，這家公司在歐洲賣出了價值超過79億歐元的商品。
它在愛爾蘭繳了大約1,750萬歐元的稅。
它的利潤大約是1.17億歐元。
這比2024年低。
這家公司在2025年平均有389名員工。
從7月起，歐盟的人購買來自歐盟以外的便宜商品要多付3歐元。
這適用於150歐元以下的商品。
這項規定是針對像Shein和Temu這樣的網路商店。
5月時，Shein也在都柏林附近開了一座新倉庫。

paragraphs: The online fashion company Shein sold more than €7.9 billion of goods in Europe last year through its company in Ireland. The company, called Infinite Styles Ecommerce, is the group's main business in Europe. Its office is in Grand Canal Dock in Dublin.

The company's total income in 2025 was €8.2 billion, down about 16 per cent from €9.8 billion in 2024. Its profit after tax fell from €137.6 million to almost €117 million. It paid almost €17.5 million in Irish company tax. The number of staff rose from 254 to 389.

These figures cover the last full year before a new EU charge started. Since July, a flat fee of €3 is added to goods worth up to €150 that people buy from outside the EU. The rule was first planned for 2028, but it was brought forward. It is aimed at cheap online sellers such as Shein and Temu.
Shein joined the Hong Kong Stock Exchange in September. In May, it opened a new centre for deliveries and returns in Rathcoole, Co Dublin.
sentZh: 網路時尚公司Shein去年透過它在愛爾蘭的公司，在歐洲賣出超過79億歐元的商品。
這家名為Infinite Styles Ecommerce的公司是該集團在歐洲的主要事業。
它的辦公室位於都柏林的大運河碼頭區。
這家公司2025年的總收入為82億歐元，比2024年的98億歐元減少約16%。
它的稅後利潤從1.376億歐元降到將近1.17億歐元。
它繳了將近1,750萬歐元的愛爾蘭公司稅。
員工人數從254人增加到389人。
這些數字涵蓋的是歐盟新收費開始前的最後一個完整年度。
從7月起，人們從歐盟以外購買價值150歐元以下的商品，會被加收3歐元的固定費用。
這項規定原本計畫在2028年實施，但被提前了。
它的目標是像Shein和Temu這樣的廉價網路賣家。
Shein在9月登上香港證券交易所。
5月時，它在都柏林郡的拉斯庫爾開設了一個新的配送與退貨中心。

paragraphs: Shein sold more than €7.9 billion worth of goods through its Irish-registered European arm in 2025, the last full year before the EU introduced new charges on low-value imports. The business, Infinite Styles Ecommerce, is based at Shein's regional headquarters in Grand Canal Dock, Dublin, and owns the group's trading companies in France, Germany and Belgium.

According to its accounts, revenue fell by around 16 per cent to €8.2 billion, compared with €9.8 billion in 2024. After-tax profit dropped from €137.6 million to almost €117 million, while the company paid nearly €17.5 million in Irish corporation tax. Average staff numbers increased from 254 to 389.

Since July, a flat charge of €3 has applied to goods worth up to €150 bought from outside the EU. The measure, originally planned for 2028, was fast-tracked to target low-cost sellers such as Shein and Temu. The European Commission says almost six billion low-value items were shipped directly to EU consumers last year.
Shein listed on the Hong Kong Stock Exchange in September and opened a logistics centre for orders and returns in Rathcoole, Co Dublin, in May.
sentZh: Shein在2025年透過其在愛爾蘭註冊的歐洲分支賣出價值超過79億歐元的商品，那是歐盟對低價進口品推出新收費前的最後一個完整年度。
這家名為Infinite Styles Ecommerce的企業設在Shein位於都柏林大運河碼頭區的區域總部，並擁有該集團在法國、德國和比利時的貿易公司。
根據其帳目，營收下降約16%至82億歐元，而2024年為98億歐元。
稅後利潤從1.376億歐元降至將近1.17億歐元，同時公司繳納了近1,750萬歐元的愛爾蘭公司稅。
平均員工人數從254人增加到389人。
自7月起，從歐盟以外購買價值150歐元以下的商品須支付3歐元的固定費用。
這項措施原定2028年實施，後來被加速推行，以針對Shein和Temu等低價賣家。
歐盟執委會表示，去年有將近60億件低價商品直接運送給歐盟消費者。
Shein在9月於香港證券交易所上市，並在5月於都柏林郡拉斯庫爾開設了處理訂單與退貨的物流中心。

paragraphs: Fast-fashion giant Shein channelled more than €7.9 billion in European sales through its Irish-registered arm in 2025, the final full year before Brussels imposed fresh levies on low-value imports. The entity, Infinite Styles Ecommerce, operates from Shein's regional headquarters in Dublin's Grand Canal Dock and is the sole owner of the group's trading subsidiaries in France, Germany and Belgium.

Its accounts reveal that turnover slid by roughly 16 per cent to €8.2 billion, down from €9.8 billion a year earlier. Post-tax profit dipped from €137.6 million to just under €117 million, and the firm contributed almost €17.5 million in Irish corporation tax. Average headcount, meanwhile, swelled from 254 to 389.

Since July, a flat €3 duty has been levied on parcels worth up to €150 arriving from outside the bloc. Initially slated for 2028, the measure was fast-tracked in a bid to rein in bargain retailers such as Shein and Temu. According to the European Commission, almost six billion low-value items were dispatched directly to EU shoppers last year.
Shein floated on the Hong Kong Stock Exchange in September, having opened a fulfilment and returns hub in Rathcoole, Co Dublin, in May.

這個實體名為Infinite Styles Ecommerce，在Shein位於都柏林大運河碼頭區的區域總部營運，是該集團在法國、德國和比利時各貿易子公司的唯一所有者。

稅後利潤從1.376億歐元小幅下降至略低於1.17億歐元，該公司貢獻了將近1,750萬歐元的愛爾蘭公司稅。
與此同時，平均員工人數從254人擴增到389人。

Shein在9月於香港證券交易所掛牌上市，此前已於5月在都柏林郡拉斯庫爾開設了訂單履行與退貨中心。

paragraphs: Shein generated more than €7.9 billion in European sales through its Irish-registered subsidiary in 2025, the final full year prior to the introduction of new EU charges on low-value imports. The entity, Infinite Styles Ecommerce, is headquartered in Grand Canal Dock, Dublin, and functions as the sole shareholder of the group's trading companies in France, Germany and Belgium.

Its financial statements indicate that revenue declined by approximately 16 per cent to €8.2 billion, compared with €9.8 billion in 2024. Consequently, post-tax profit decreased from €137.6 million to almost €117 million, while the company's Irish corporation tax liability amounted to nearly €17.5 million. Average employee numbers, by contrast, rose substantially from 254 to 389.

Since July, a uniform €3 charge has been applied to goods valued at up to €150 purchased from outside the EU. The measure, originally scheduled for 2028, was accelerated in order to address the proliferation of inexpensive online retailers such as Shein and Temu. The European Commission estimates that almost six billion low-value items were shipped directly to EU consumers last year.
Shein was listed on the Hong Kong Stock Exchange in September, and in May it established a regional fulfilment and returns facility in Rathcoole, Co Dublin.
